title: NAEOS: A Declarative Engineering Runtime for Specification-Driven, AI-Native Software Construction
description: Technical monograph on NAEOS ("Specify Once. Build Anywhere."), an open-source declarative engineering runtime. Covers the NEIR canonical intermediate representation (fourteen domains, semver schema governance), the nine-stage deterministic compilation pipeline, executable governance compiled from an Engineering Constitution, vendor-neutral AI integration (six-agent instruction compiler + MCP server), and WASM-based plugin sandboxing. Includes executed empirical evaluation: byte-identical determinism across independent runs (79 artifacts), replicated benchmarks on two hardware platforms across three model scales.
